content: Once a vial is punctured, it must not be reused. The medication should be taken within 30 minutes after consuming a full meal that contains a moderate or high amount of fat. Capsules should be stored in their original bottle at a temperature of 20-25°C (68-77°F), with permissible temperature excursions ranging from 15-30°C (59-86°F). Unopened vials should be refrigerated at 2-8°C (36-46°F) and must not be frozen. Adding plans allows for the comparison of formulary status with other drugs in the same class. To access formulary information, you must first create a list of plans. This list will be saved and can be edited at any time. Adding plans enables you to perform these comparisons. The information provided is intended for general informational and educational purposes only. Individual plans may vary, and formulary details are subject to change. For the most accurate and up-to-date information, contact the relevant plan provider directly. When sending information to a recipient, they will receive additional details and instructions on how to access the offer.
